question: The value of 48 ÷ [5 + {19 - (16 - 16 ÷ 4 × 3 of 2)}] is:
solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e88f2c958b15f566f943ec5d9b049b059d3f8ea52aa2135423fd7e1435460ed.png] 

**Given:**

48 ÷ [5 + {19 - (16 - 16 ÷ 4 × 3 of 2)}]

**Calculation:**

48 ÷ [5 + {19 - (16 - 16 ÷ 4 × 3 of 2)}]

⇒ 48 ÷ [5 + {19 - (16 - 4 × 3 × 2 )}]

⇒ 48 ÷ [5 + {19 - (-8)}]

⇒ 48 ÷ [5 + {19 + 8}]

⇒ 48 ÷ [5 + 27]

⇒ 48/32

⇒ 3/2

**∴ The required result = 3/2**
